description: Shared vectors for display rules (RPD-339). Run by FieldDisplayRuleVectorsTest (Java) and displayRuleVectors.test.ts (TypeScript); both implementations must agree on every case. Valid rules are compared by JSON value, not by bytes. Keys are UUIDs; K1 is 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 and so on. A field's sourceKind (OPTIONS, TEXT, NUMBER or NONE) defaults to OPTIONS for RADIO and CHOICE and NONE otherwise; value is the raw text of a TEXT or NUMBER field and defaults to empty.

limits.description: Generated rules at the size limits. Field 0 (K1) is a RADIO field offering every value; field 1 (K2) is a STRING field with an IS_ANY_OF rule on K1. Value i (from 0) is pad repeated padCount times followed by i as five zero-padded digits; when tailLength is positive, one more value of that many 'x' characters follows. jsonLength is the length of the rule as Java's toJson() writes it, with every non-ASCII UTF-16 unit escaped.
